name: Full Smile
verdict: Full Smile delivered 121 leads at a $10.57 CPL over the last 28 days, driven almost entirely by Meta (top campaign: "BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting" at $690.19 spend). The biggest movement in the last 7 days is a 57.73% drop in Instagram engagement, likely tied to the 28.74% spend pullback on Meta, which also contributed to the 13.33% dip in leads week over week.

performance.verdict: CPL improving but spend halved — volume risk entering prove-it month.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — scoreboard data unreliable.
CPL dropped 17.77% to ~$10.57 as spend fell 28.74% — efficiency improved but daily spend is now $25.62, lowest in 45-day series, compressing lead volume.
3-day signal (Aug 23–25): spend $36.22/$31.01/$27.98 trending down; leads 6/8/3 — erratic but averaging 5.7/day vs prior 3-day avg of 3.0/day. Volume holding despite budget cut.
GHL shows 96 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments in 28 days against 121 leads — intake pipeline is not converting; this is a CRM/intake leak, not an ads problem.

IG reach collapsed from ~300/day in late July to 90–113 last 3 days (−57.73% 7d), tracking the Meta spend cut; organic GBP actions also fell 21.31% — no independent organic lift offsetting paid pullback.

suggestions.text: Escalate attribution gap and CRM cleanup immediately — 0 won opps from 121 leads breaks the August scoreboard by Aug 29.
suggestions.monday_update: Phone-match attribution (due Aug 7) and sync/contact cleanup (due Aug 14) are both overdue — escalate to Ahmed Memon/Ali Shaheer now. With 121 leads and 0 opportunities won in 28 days, the client's scoreboard (leads → scheduled → shown → patients) cannot be measured or defended. Success check: attribution gap closed and GHL showing appointment bookings by 2026-08-29.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +20% from ~$25.62/day — CPL is strong at $10.57 and 3-day lead rate holds; spending into prove-it month at series lows is the real risk.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL has improved 17.77% to $10.57 while spend dropped to a 45-day low of $25.62/day. The last 3 days averaged 5.7 leads/day despite the cut, indicating room to recover volume without sacrificing efficiency. Raise the daily budget approximately 20% (to ~$31/day). Success check: leads/day hold above 5 and CPL stays below $13 by 2026-08-29.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL pipeline: if appointments remain 0 after attribution fix by Aug 29, escalate as intake process failure, not ads failure.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL currently shows 96 opportunities created and 0 appointments in the 28-day window despite 121 leads — this is an intake leak, not an ads problem. Hold ad scaling judgment until the attribution fix (S1) is live and appointment data is trustworthy. Re-check on 2026-08-29: if appointments are still 0, escalate to Lily and the new intake hire as a process failure.
